---
title: "setupmjr"
toc: true
---

`setupmjr` is a cross-platform setup utility.

## Commands

```text
setupmjr - Cross-platform setup utility
Commands:
  hpc
  hpc scratch
  hpc apptainer
  hpc slurm
  hpc git
  hpc r [--not-radian] [--not-lintr] [--switch-r]
  shell <shell> rc.d
  shell <shell> path
  shell <shell> login [--not-profile]
  bash rc.d
  bash path
  bash login [--not-profile]
  r [--not-radian] [--not-lintr] [--switch-r]
  git
  git profile
  git auth [text|cache|mngr] [--system|--local] [--remove]
  repo readme
  repo devcontainer [--repo <owner/repo>@<branch>] [--build]
  repo action <action-name>
  install [--repos] [--pj] [--gh-skill]
  agent [-a <endpoint>] [-p [g|d]] [-c [o|d]] [-s [agy|deepseek]] [--config] [--list]
```
